name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.8 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 23 times in 9 visits over 51 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 46 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.1 days starting 2025-10-20, at wavelengths from 0.94 to 4.99 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
